description: Monitor autonomous-work sessions for premature stalls and inject a bounded continue prompt

hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run-autonomous-work-hook.sh" ]; then sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run-autonomous-work-hook.sh" --harness claude; elif [ -f "$HOME/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/repo-tools/plugins/repo-tools/scripts/run-autonomous-work-hook.sh" ]; then sh "$HOME/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/repo-tools/plugins/repo-tools/scripts/run-autonomous-work-hook.sh" --harness claude; else printf '{}\n'; fi
